pass1.sentence: Burns are skin damage from dry heat such as fire or a hot object, and scalds are skin damage from hot liquid or steam.

pass1.sentence: Deep burns of any size can cause white or charred skin, while less deep burns tend to cause blisters.

pass1.sentence: Size is often judged against the injured person's own hand.
